def init_identity():
    p = Path('/proc/101')
    st = (p / 'stat').read_text().split(') ', 1)[1].split()
    assert st[0] not in ('Z', 'T', 't') and st[19] == '123' and (st[1] == '1')
    assert (p / 'cmdline').read_bytes() == b'/bin/bash\x00/tmp/fixture-init.sh\x00'
    return {'birth': st[19], 'argv_sha256': filehash(p / 'cmdline'), 'uid': p.stat().st_uid}
init_before = init_identity()
assert init_before['uid'] == 1001
